281795504.description:
Decorative Stone Egg Lot - 7 Pieces
Polished Marble, Onyx, Calcite, and Mineral Specimens
Includes 2 Ornate Metal Display Stands
A distinctive collection of seven carved and polished natural stone eggs featuring varied mineral compositions, banded patterns, and rich colorations. Polished hardstone eggs have long been collected as tactile curios and decorative accents, showcasing the natural geological beauty of stones such as onyx, marble, and quartz. Each piece exhibits smooth contours and an all-around gloss polish.
Items Included:
Banded onyx/calcite egg with cream and tan strata
White and grey veined marble egg on stand
Cobalt blue quartz/mineral egg on stand
Polished red jasper/marble egg
Bright yellow calcite/alabaster egg
Swirled grey and white marble egg
Petite purple lepidolite/fluorite egg
Two ornate gold-tone metal tripod display stands
Condition:
All eggs remain in good condition with smooth, lustrous finishes. Minor natural mineral pits and internal fissures characteristic of authentic stone lapidary specimens. Both metal tripod stands are structurally sound and stable with light age-appropriate patina.
